**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retain failures that occur during preflight**

When any check before `args.output.mkdir(...)` fails—such as a missing or corrupt model file, an incorrect RVL revision, or a patch-hash mismatch—the output directory does not yet exist, so this `is_dir()` condition suppresses `failure.json` entirely. These are declared protocol failures, but the run leaves no raw failure record; create the directory before preflight or write an equivalent failure artifact from this handler.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L48-L52](https://github.com/mitukx/VARE/blob/026a6f27982317b184030ce743915cf03f78a471/AGENTS.md#L48-L52)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Fixed in 0efd7c6. The runner atomically reserves a new output directory before preflight and records ownership, so missing/corrupt inputs retain failure.json while pre-existing or concurrently reserved outputs are not overwritten. New regressions reproduce two failures on the reviewed source; normal and optimized Python plus the existing-output control now pass (3 tests). Frozen v3 artifacts remain unchanged; v4 pins the revised runner and fresh diagnostic seeds.
